summary: Analysis is well-aligned with agent-mode design principles. Phase 1 (CI gating) is pure infrastructure with no agent-design concerns. Phase 2 (DinD for SDLC self-testing) correctly separates infrastructure provisioning (orchestrator manages DinD sidecar) from agent execution (tester agent runs tests autonomously via DOCKER_HOST). The sandbox trust model is properly respected — Docker access restrictions are enforced at the infrastructure level, not via prompt instructions. Option D was correctly rejected for violating the trust boundary. No agent-mode anti-patterns detected.
